t: This is 37 to 43 Park Street, in Westminster, in the W1 postcode. The building was designed by William Douglas Caroe, an English architect. That's the main fact I have for this address, so I won't pad it out. Take a look at the frontage and the street around it, and notice how it sits among its neighbours. Sometimes a building is best appreciated simply by knowing who drew it up, and here that name is Caroe.
